name: convertkoro-site
description: Static site + Netlify Functions for convertkoro.com. @netlify/blobs is required for the URL Shortener's server-backed short links (shorten.js, redirect.js) and the server-side video compression pipeline (video-upload-chunk.js, video-compress-background.js, video-job-status.js, video-download-chunk.js, video-compress-start.js), which stores uploaded video chunks and compressed results there. ffmpeg-static provides a real, statically-linked ffmpeg binary for genuine server-side video compression (see video-compress-background.js for why this replaced the previous fully client-side ffmpeg.wasm approach).
